description.p: Evaluate the system against SCAP Security Guide profiles such as CIS, STIG, PCI DSS or ANSSI directly from the Cockpit web console.

ul.li: Run scans with live progress and browse every rule result
Customize profiles by enabling rules and adjusting values (XCCDF tailoring)
Review and apply generated remediation, then re-scan to verify
Schedule unattended scans with a systemd timer
Download HTML reports and ARF results
